steps.title: Define App Metadata
steps.description: Establish the application name and native package namespace for compilation.

steps.title: Configure Build Environment
steps.description: Set up Gradle build configurations including compilation SDK version 34 and tool chain versions.

steps.title: Declare Manifest Information
steps.description: Register application nodes, screen configurations, and launcher attributes in AndroidManifest.xml.

steps.title: Create Modern Theme Color Definitions
steps.description: Establish hex color mappings for a premium dark styling of display monitors and active text states.

steps.title: Configure Display Border Shape
steps.description: Establish a rounded-corner shape for the digital display output screen.

steps.title: Implement Number Button Selector States
steps.description: Create rounded-corner shapes with active highlight states for keying in numeric values.

steps.title: Implement Operator Button Selector States
steps.description: Create vivid accent color selectors for essential mathematical operators like add, subtract, multiply, and divide.

steps.title: Implement Action Button Selector States
steps.description: Style secondary action keys (Clear, Backspace, Percent) with balanced gray selectors.

steps.title: Implement Equals Button Selector States
steps.description: Design a glowing blue accent key selector for triggers evaluating equations.

steps.title: Design Beautiful Calculator Layout UI
steps.description: Construct the session history monitor, current expression scrollbars, and key grid structure inside activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Implement Native Expression Parsing Engine
steps.description: Write a parsing algorithm with order-of-precedence calculation rules and support for percent and negative prefixes.

steps.title: Map UI Keypad Bindings
steps.description: Connect key press listeners using classic anonymous listeners with robust live expression evaluation feedback.

steps.title: Building Modern Calculator
steps.description: Final compile and verify build outputs to complete modern calculator app bundle.
